pages.text: The bag can store a single kind of tagged item. In your inventory, use the secondary click with the bag and item to put it in or take it out.

pages.title: Pick Up & Empty
pages.text: Use the bag on eligible dropped items to collect them. Use it in the air to spill a stack, or sneak-use to spill one. A dispenser can dispense the contents item by item.

pages.title: In-Game Recovery
pages.text: The mod tracks recent stomach contents. Vomiting can expel them and interrupt pending absorption. An eligible empty bag can help contain the mess. Active effects fade on their own timers.
